get.description: Returns time-series health metrics for a single cluster node - memory, disk and CPU utilisation, disk IOPS, and per-NIC network in/out throughput. Each metric is a `{ labels, results }` pair (labels are timestamps, results are values). The path takes a node id (e.g. the `master_node_id` from List / Detail, or a node `id` from Monitoring Nodes). Use `interval` to set the look-back window in seconds.
